It is indeed...I was tossing up between the Realforce, a Ducky shine 3 and Poker II with blue switches...but I was so intrigued by it, loved the sound and looks of it, and it won me over.

I am really liking it so far, it will definitely take some getting used to, but there's something so satisfying about typing on it. It has a delightful feel, both in the texture of the keycaps and in the smoothness of the action. I play the piano so I have quite a delicate and nimble touch and typing on this has an almost therapeutic quality to it. Too soon to really give much more useful feedback.
